documents.title: Google for Education: A world of perspectives on the future of learning
documents.summary: Turning future-of-education research into a global video series for Google for Education Google for Education commissioned a Future of Education research study and wanted to bring its findings to life. The goal was to create content that shared meaningful perspectives from educators while building a stronger thought leadership platform. Journey Article Group created an ongoing video series that positioned Google for Education as a pioneer at the intersection of technology and education.
